name: Bryan College
tuition_note: 2026-27 from bryan.edu/admissions/tuition-fees/. Private school single rate: tuition $21,700/yr + Enhanced Student Experience Fee $1,500 (12+ hrs) = $23,200 tuition & fees. Housing is room only (traditional dorm) $5,650/yr; board (meal plan) $3,900/yr listed separately.
